title: Outgrow
statement: Growth sometimes requires stepping beyond the boundaries that have become too confining.

versions.title: First interpretation
versions.author: codex
versions.summary: First interpretation: concentric shell, repeated strikes, figure eight and rosette, winged form.

versions.title: Wings
versions.author: claude
versions.summary: Faster rework: one continuous set of 24 lines morphs from rings to wings; reactive camera.

versions.title: Text ending
versions.author: claude
versions.summary: The soul flies an S-curve out of the wings; a spark writes Break / the shape. / Keep / becoming.

versions.title: Comments ending
versions.author: claude
versions.summary: The soul inhales the old words, writes Meaning / in the / comments., then enters lines that converge on a comment bubble beside the real button.

studies.title: Transformation map
studies.author: owner
studies.source: projects/outgrow/references/images/From concentric circles to winged symmetry.png
studies.note: The whole arc on one sheet: concentric rings, a stretched oval, a pinch, and the winged form.

studies.title: Seed in a silent shell
studies.author: owner
studies.source: projects/outgrow/references/images/Amber Seed in a Silent Shell-1.png
studies.note: Stillness before the first attempt. Motion only; not its blue or gold.

studies.title: Contour vocabulary
studies.author: owner
studies.note: Spirals, pinches, figure eights and ribbons for the middle of the film.

studies.title: Figure-eight escape
studies.author: owner
studies.note: The soul slipping through an asymmetric figure eight.

studies.title: Orbital bloom
studies.author: owner
studies.note: Radial expansion for a possible rosette stage.

studies.title: Ruptured shell
studies.author: owner
studies.note: Breakthrough energy: a bloom inside a shell that starts to tear.

studies.title: Winged seed
studies.author: owner
studies.note: The final form: clean symmetric wings around a vertical orange seed.

studies.title: Review sheet
studies.author: codex
studies.note: Nine sampled frames of version 01, used to check the beats before publishing.

studies.title: Beyond the frame
studies.author: codex
studies.note: Oversized asymmetric wings run off the edges; the words sit in the black space.

studies.title: Between the wings
studies.author: codex
studies.note: A symmetric passage between the wings frames the headline.

studies.title: Under pressure
studies.author: codex
studies.note: A resisting shell wraps tightly around the words.

studies.title: Trace of freedom
studies.author: codex
studies.note: Wings low, an orange S-trace rising to the soul, text on the left. Chosen for refinement.

studies.title: Words as shell
studies.author: codex
studies.note: Huge type becomes the structure the soul threads through.

studies.title: Larger type
studies.author: codex
studies.note: The headline grows to four left-aligned lines: Break / the shape. / Keep / becoming.

studies.title: Orange nouns
studies.author: codex
studies.note: Colour test with the nouns in orange. Dropped in favour of orange verbs.

studies.title: Orange verbs
studies.author: owner
studies.note: Only Break and Keep in orange. The target frame for version 03.

studies.title: Comment arrow
studies.author: codex
studies.note: A curved orange arrow toward the comment button. Proposed, not in the film.

studies.title: Meaning in the comments
studies.author: owner
studies.note: Target frame for the comments ending. In the film the bubble moves slightly down and left, the text sits lower and the soul's trace is gone, so the bubble is the focus.
